timeline: You might think a simple town dump fire can be put out in an afternoon, but this one has been burning since 1962.
At the heart of the fire, temperatures easily exceeded one thousand degrees.
Initial excavation and flushing projects ultimately failed to stop the spread.
A gas station owner lowered a thermometer into his underground tank and found the gasoline was 172 degrees.
Fissures and dangerous gases began appearing throughout the area.
Fifteen hundred residents lived there when the fire started, before the town was mostly abandoned in the 1980s.
